gloss: yellow autumn leaves; leaves turning yellow

definitions.gloss: yellow autumn leaves; leaves turning yellow in autumn
definitions.explanation: The phenomenon of tree leaves turning yellow in autumn, or the yellow leaves themselves. Distinguished from the more general kouyou ({紅葉|こうよう}, red leaves) by specifically referring to yellow coloration, as seen in ginkgo and birch trees.

examples.japanese: イチョウ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黄葉|こうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The yellow autumn leaves of the ginkgo are beautiful.

examples.japanese: {黄葉|こうよう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{並木道|なみきみち}→並木道：17520_namikimichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: To take a walk along a tree-lined avenue with yellow autumn leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{黄葉|こうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{彩|いろど}り→彩る：12542_irodoru⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, red and yellow leaves color the mountains, and many tourists visit.

notes:
Written with {黄|こう} (yellow) + {葉|よう} (leaf), in contrast to ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧ which uses {紅|こう} (crimson). Both are read こうよう, and in everyday speech ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧ is often used as a general term for all autumn foliage including yellow leaves. {黄葉|こうよう} is used when specifically distinguishing yellow coloration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄葉|こうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn yellow (of leaves)
- {黄葉|こうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見頃|みごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧: the yellow leaves are at their peak
- イチョウ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黄葉|こうよう}: ginkgo yellow leaves
- ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{黄葉|こうよう}: red and yellow autumn leaves

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧: autumn leaves (red) — the general term for autumn foliage; homophone
- ⟦{落葉|らくよう}→落葉：17301_rakuyou⟧: fallen leaves — leaves that have already fallen from the tree
- ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧: fresh green leaves — the spring equivalent: new green foliage

USAGE:
The representative tree for {黄葉|こうよう} is the イチョウ (ginkgo), whose brilliant golden leaves are iconic in Japanese autumn scenery. The ginkgo-lined avenue at {明治神宮外苑|めいじじんぐうがいえん} in Tokyo is one of the most famous {黄葉|こうよう} spots in Japan.
